purpose: Missing or incomplete CROSS-REGION skilling tool and supply chains for Equilibrium no-trade planning. Complements progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-2026-07-25, -gaps-2026-07-26, and -outfits-2026-07-25 with fuller component region_hints, three-region smithing stacks, porter/GOTE supply, crystal dragon-base pressure, Invention machine geography, and tier-100 tool follow-ons.

policy.region_rule: region_hints marks every region that participates in the normal self-sufficient chain. required_regions is only set when every listed region is needed to finish the finished item or full stack without trade. optional_pressure_regions improve throughput or alternate sourcing but are not hard locks. Quest auto-completion and League overrides apply separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise untradeable finished tools, permanent unlocks, and self-sourced intermediate bases. Tradeable intermediates stay as supply pressure, not hard region gates, unless the craft or shop is region-locked.
policy.rate_rule: Do not invent XP/hour figures. Record unlock state, effects, and multi-region pressure only.
policy.completeness_rule: Re-emit an existing cross-region id only when the prior row omitted a hard component region, craft facility, or third-stack partner. New ids cover previously unmodeled chains.

equipment_additions.name: Pickaxe of Earth and Song
requirements: 90 Smithing (boostable; cannot be assisted)
90 Mining to use
Imcando pickaxe (Birthright of the Dwarves; Lava Flow Mine gilding + four Imcando fragments)
Crystal pickaxe (dragon pickaxe or Imcando/gilded dragon base + 4,000 harmonic dust at Lady Ithell; Plague's End)
Blast fusion hammer (1,000,000 coins from Blast Furnace Foreman in Keldagrim after While Guthix Sleeps)
Smith at the dragonkin anvil in the Dragon forge (Ancient Cavern; Relight My Fire post-quest)

Feeds Pickaxe of Life and Death tier-100 upgrade at Ramarno

equipment_additions.category: cross-region Smithing and Firemaking full AFK stack
requirements: Orthen furnace core: 99 Smithing, 102 Archaeology; 4 restored dragon burners from Orthen Observation outpost; 2 curved masterwork melee plates; listed consumable ingredients
Superheat Form: The Light Within / Seren prayers, 91 Prayer, Ancient Curses
Smithing autoheater (Daemonheim Rewards): 35 Smithing + 35 Dungeoneering, 4,000 tokens; advanced upgrade 70/70 + 40,000 tokens
Crystal hammer (Tirannwn) for the optimal tool half of the stack
Scroll of efficiency (Daemonheim) multiplies with furnace core bar-refund chance
effects: Furnace core off-hand: negates Superheat Form prayer drain when equipped before activating the prayer
Superheat Form: auto-burn logs while Woodcutting; faster smelting; low heat treated as medium and medium as high while smithing
Autoheater: restores heat from metal-bank coal at 0% heat; with Superheat Form enables fully AFK medium-high heat smithing
Furnace core multiplies scroll of efficiency refund chance by 1.25 (2% → 2.5%)
Pyromaniac / Breakdown procs grant temporary Furnace Core XP status
region_pressure: Anachronia owns Orthen Dig Site dragon burners and the furnace-core craft side. Do not claim dual dig sites.
Tirannwn owns Superheat Form and crystal hammer / crystal tinderbox tool half.
Forinthry owns Daemonheim smithing autoheater and scroll of efficiency permanent unlocks.
Asgarnia optional: Artisans' Workshop curved masterwork melee plates / glorious-bar infrastructure consumed by the core craft.
equipment_additions.notes: Audit combo:orthen-furnace-superheat-autoheater. Prior gaps row cross-region:orthen-furnace-core-stack only required Anachronia+Tirannwn and treated autoheater as optional partner. This row models the full three-region AFK stack planners actually optimise for.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Surface Anachronia + Tirannwn + Forinthry together when ranking fully AFK late smithing. Keep Asgarnia as masterwork-plate pressure. Never imply Moonrise is part of this stack.

equipment_additions.name: Grace of the elves / signs of the porter supply chain
equipment_additions.category: cross-region gathering necklace and porter charge supply
requirements: 107 Invention to discover and manufacture alchemical onyx (onyx + 50 fortunate + 50 refined + 10 precious at inventor's workbench)
91 Crafting to smelt alchemical onyx necklace (gold bar + alchemical onyx)

effects: Halves drain of Light Form, Superheat Form, and Chronicle Attraction while worn (zero drain with Dark Facet of Grace)
10% chance per minute for a Seren spirit rare-drop-table bank deposit while gathering
Acts as a sign of the porter while charged (ores → metal bank; Archaeology materials → material storage)
Two configurable Max Guild skill-portal teleports when attuned
region_pressure: Asgarnia: Invention Guild / inventor's workbench is the natural alchemical-onyx manufacture hub.
Tirannwn: Max Guild garden portal attunement; Seren prayer value pairing; incandescent energy south of the Poison Waste for porter VII.

equipment_additions.name: Invention machines (Invention Guild + Fort Workshop power)
requirements: Invention tutorial complete (80 Crafting, Divination, Smithing)
60 Invention for machine tutorial and first hotspots
Machine hotspots are built only in the Invention Guild basement north-east of Falador
Generator upgrades: simple (60), large (80), jumbo (102 Invention)
Tier-2 full set needs 260 power; jumbo generator provides 160 (200 with tier-3 Fort Forinthry Workshop)
effects: Auto disassembler / mk II: offline disassemble for components
Alchemiser / mk II: offline High Alchemy
Plank maker / high capacity: logs → planks without coins
Partial potion producer / DX: clean herbs → unfinished potions
Automatic / optimised hide tanner: free hide tanning
Machines tick hourly including while offline; powered by divine charges → machine charge
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-gates the Invention Guild machine room — machines are not portable scenery and cannot be built elsewhere.
Misthalin optional: Fort Forinthry tier-3 Workshop grants +40 generator power allotment (160 → 200), enabling denser tier-2 machine layouts.
Inventor's workbenches for devices/blueprints exist in multiple cities; do not confuse workbench access with machine hotspots.
equipment_additions.notes: Machines are region-gated to the Guild. Workbenches are multi-city and not machine hotspots. Jumbo power math means full five tier-2 machines is impossible even with Fort bonus (200 < 260).
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia dependency for machine AFK processing. Fort Forinthry power bonus uses the working Misthalin taxonomy. Do not invent off-site machine rooms.
